chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

"Whoever wishes that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, shade him on the Day when there will be no shade except His shade, then let him grant respite to an insolvent person or leave for him some of his due."

key_terms.ظِلُّهُ: His shade, meaning Allah’s exclusive protection and mercy
key_terms.مُعْسِرًا: a person in financial hardship or insolvency
key_terms.يُظِلَّهُ: shade him and grant him divine protection

ai.seo_question: How can a person earn Allah’s shade on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that showing ease to a debtor in hardship is a cause of divine mercy on the Day of Judgment. Granting delay or waiving part of a debt is presented as a deed with immense afterlife reward.
